```{r data}
data <- read.csv("/Users/graysonschultz/Downloads/corruptiondata.csv")

# ---- choose the analysis in ONE place -----------------------------------
outcome    <- "ncorrupt_os"    # "ncorrupt_os", "pcorrupt", or "valor_corrupt"
binarize   <- TRUE             # 1 = any corruption found, 0 = none
spec       <- "mayoral_muni"   # which confounder set (see cov_sets below)
treatment  <- "first"          # first-term mayor indicator
# -------------------------------------------------------------------------

state_fe <- paste0("uf_d", 1:26)
cov_sets <- list(
  mayoral          = c("pref_idade_tse", "pref_escola"),
  mayoral_muni     = c("pref_idade_tse", "pref_escola", "mun_novo", "p_secundario",
                       "purb", "lpib02", "gini_ipea", "op_01_04"),
  mayoral_muni_pol = c("pref_idade_tse", "pref_escola", "mun_novo", "p_secundario",
                       "purb", "lpib02", "gini_ipea", "op_01_04",
                       "p_cad_pref", "ENLP2000"),
  selected_cov     = c("pref_idade_tse", "pref_escola", "mun_novo", "p_secundario",
                       "purb", "lpib02", "gini_ipea", "op_01_04",
                       "p_cad_pref", "ENLP2000", state_fe)
)
covariates   <- cov_sets[[spec]]
formula_used <- reformulate(c(treatment, covariates), response = outcome)

# Binarize the chosen outcome BEFORE building the modeling frame, so the SAME
# 0/1 outcome flows into both the propensity plot and the DML estimators.
if (binarize) data[[outcome]] <- as.integer(data[[outcome]] > 0)

# Modeling frame: outcome + treatment + covariates, with numeric NAs mean-imputed.
model_val <- as.data.frame(model.frame(formula_used, data))
model_val[] <- lapply(model_val, function(col) {
  if (is.numeric(col)) col[is.na(col)] <- mean(col, na.rm = TRUE)
  col
})
x_val <- setdiff(colnames(model_val), c(outcome, treatment))
```

```{r propensity-plot}
# A propensity model is P(treatment = 1 | X) -- treatment regressed on covariates
# (the earlier version regressed the OUTCOME on treatment + X, which is not a
# propensity score). This chunk is exploratory; the DML functions estimate their
# own m(X) internally via cross-fitting.
prop_formula     <- reformulate(covariates, response = treatment)
propensity_model <- glm(prop_formula, data = model_val,
                        family = binomial(link = "logit"))
model_val$propensity_score <- predict(propensity_model, type = "response")

model_val$treatment_f <- factor(model_val[[treatment]],
                                levels = c(0, 1),
                                labels = c("Second-term", "First-term"))

ggplot(model_val, aes(x = propensity_score, fill = treatment_f)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 30, alpha = 0.5, position = "identity") +
  labs(title = "Propensity score distribution by treatment",
       x = "Propensity score  P(first-term = 1 | X)", y = "Count",
       fill = NULL)
```

```{r learners}
# Fit a specified ML model. For nnet, the imputation + standardization params are
# computed on the TRAINING data and stored on the model, so prediction applies the
# identical transform (the previous version re-scaled the test fold on its own
# stats -> a train/test mismatch that made the nnet fits unreliable).
fit_model <- function(X, Y, model_type = "lasso", ...) {
  X <- as.matrix(X)
  if (model_type == "lasso") {
    nf <- max(3, min(10, floor(nrow(X) / 10)))  # robust to small subsets (IRM arms)
    return(cv.glmnet(X, Y, alpha = 1, family = "gaussian", nfolds = nf))
  } else if (model_type == "rf") {
    return(randomForest(x = X, y = Y, ...))
  } else if (model_type == "tree") {
    return(rpart(Y ~ ., data = data.frame(X, Y = Y)))
  } else if (model_type == "nnet") {
    centers <- colMeans(X, na.rm = TRUE)
    X_imp   <- sweep(X, 2, centers, "-")         # center on training means
    X_imp[is.na(X_imp)] <- 0                      # NA -> centered mean (0)
    scales  <- apply(X_imp, 2, sd)
    scales[scales == 0 | is.na(scales)] <- 1      # guard constant columns
    X_scaled <- sweep(X_imp, 2, scales, "/")
    model <- nnet(X_scaled, Y, size = 5, decay = 1e-2, linout = TRUE,
                  trace = FALSE, maxit = 300, ...)  # decay stabilizes the fit
    attr(model, "prep") <- list(center = centers, scale = scales)
    return(model)
  } else {
    stop("Unsupported model type")
  }
}

# Predict with a fitted model, applying the model's stored training transform.
predict_model <- function(model, X_new, model_type = "lasso") {
  X_new <- as.matrix(X_new)
  if (model_type == "lasso") {
    return(as.vector(predict(model, newx = X_new, s = "lambda.min")))
  } else if (model_type %in% c("rf", "tree")) {
    if (any(is.na(X_new))) {                       # per-column mean imputation
      cm <- colMeans(X_new, na.rm = TRUE)
      for (j in seq_len(ncol(X_new))) X_new[is.na(X_new[, j]), j] <- cm[j]
    }
    return(predict(model, newdata = data.frame(X_new)))
  } else if (model_type == "nnet") {
    prep    <- attr(model, "prep")                 # TRAINING center/scale
    X_imp   <- sweep(X_new, 2, prep$center, "-")
    X_imp[is.na(X_imp)] <- 0
    X_scaled <- sweep(X_imp, 2, prep$scale, "/")
    return(as.vector(predict(model, newdata = X_scaled)))
  } else {
    stop("Unsupported model type")
  }
}
```

```{r dml-plr}
# Partially Linear Regression: theta from regressing outcome residuals on
# treatment residuals (assumes an additively separable treatment effect).
double_ml_plr <- function(data, y_col, d_col, x_cols, k = 5,
                          model_g = "lasso", model_m = "lasso") {
  if (!all(c(y_col, d_col, x_cols) %in% colnames(data)))
    stop("One or more specified columns are missing in the data.")
  if (inherits(data, "data.table")) data <- as.data.frame(data)

  Y <- as.numeric(data[[y_col]])
  D <- as.numeric(data[[d_col]])
  X <- as.matrix(data[x_cols])
  n <- nrow(data)

  set.seed(123)
  folds <- createFolds(Y, k = k, list = TRUE)

  g_hat <- rep(NA_real_, n)   # E[Y | X]
  m_hat <- rep(NA_real_, n)   # E[D | X]

  for (fold in seq_len(k)) {
    test_idx  <- folds[[fold]]
    train_idx <- setdiff(seq_len(n), test_idx)
    X_train <- X[train_idx, , drop = FALSE]
    X_test  <- X[test_idx, , drop = FALSE]

    g_model <- fit_model(X_train, Y[train_idx], model_g)
    g_hat[test_idx] <- predict_model(g_model, X_test, model_g)

    m_model <- fit_model(X_train, D[train_idx], model_m)
    m_hat[test_idx] <- predict_model(m_model, X_test, model_m)
  }

  u_Y <- Y - g_hat
  u_D <- D - m_hat

  theta_model <- lm(u_Y ~ u_D - 1)
  theta <- coef(theta_model)[[1]]

  # heteroskedasticity-robust (HC0) SE, computed without an n x n matrix
  r  <- residuals(theta_model)
  bread <- solve(crossprod(u_D))                 # (u_D' u_D)^-1
  meat  <- crossprod(u_D * r)                     # u_D' diag(r^2) u_D
  std_error <- sqrt(as.numeric(bread %*% meat %*% bread))

  t_value <- theta / std_error
  p_value <- 2 * (1 - pt(abs(t_value), df = n - 1))

  list(theta = theta, std_error = std_error, t_value = t_value, p_value = p_value,
       rmse_g = sqrt(mean((Y - g_hat)^2)), rmse_m = sqrt(mean((D - m_hat)^2)))
}
```

```{r dml-irm}
# Interactive Regression Model: the outcome model is fit SEPARATELY by treatment
# arm (g1 = E[Y|D=1,X], g0 = E[Y|D=0,X]) and combined with the propensity through
# the doubly-robust (AIPW) score to estimate the ATE. This is what distinguishes
# an IRM from a PLR.
double_ml_irm <- function(data, y_col, d_col, x_cols, k = 5,
                          model_g = "lasso", model_m = "lasso",
                          trimming_threshold = 1e-2) {
  if (!all(c(y_col, d_col, x_cols) %in% colnames(data)))
    stop("One or more specified columns are missing in the data.")
  if (inherits(data, "data.table")) data <- as.data.frame(data)

  Y <- as.numeric(data[[y_col]])
  D <- as.numeric(data[[d_col]])
  X <- as.matrix(data[x_cols])
  n <- nrow(data)

  set.seed(123)
  folds <- createFolds(D, k = k, list = TRUE)     # stratify folds on treatment

  m_hat  <- rep(NA_real_, n)   # E[D | X]        (propensity)
  g1_hat <- rep(NA_real_, n)   # E[Y | D = 1, X]
  g0_hat <- rep(NA_real_, n)   # E[Y | D = 0, X]

  for (fold in seq_len(k)) {
    test_idx  <- folds[[fold]]
    train_idx <- setdiff(seq_len(n), test_idx)
    X_train <- X[train_idx, , drop = FALSE]
    X_test  <- X[test_idx, , drop = FALSE]
    D_train <- D[train_idx]
    Y_train <- Y[train_idx]

    m_model <- fit_model(X_train, D_train, model_m)         # propensity on all train
    m_hat[test_idx] <- predict_model(m_model, X_test, model_m)

    treated <- which(D_train == 1)                          # outcome models by arm
    control <- which(D_train == 0)
    g1_model <- fit_model(X_train[treated, , drop = FALSE], Y_train[treated], model_g)
    g0_model <- fit_model(X_train[control, , drop = FALSE], Y_train[control], model_g)
    g1_hat[test_idx] <- predict_model(g1_model, X_test, model_g)
    g0_hat[test_idx] <- predict_model(g0_model, X_test, model_g)
  }

  keep <- which(m_hat > trimming_threshold & m_hat < 1 - trimming_threshold)
  if (length(keep) == 0) stop("No observations left after trimming.")
  Yk <- Y[keep]; Dk <- D[keep]
  mk <- m_hat[keep]; g1k <- g1_hat[keep]; g0k <- g0_hat[keep]

  # doubly-robust (AIPW) score for the ATE
  psi <- (g1k - g0k) +
         Dk * (Yk - g1k) / mk -
         (1 - Dk) * (Yk - g0k) / (1 - mk)

  theta     <- mean(psi)
  n_keep    <- length(keep)
  std_error <- sqrt(mean((psi - theta)^2) / n_keep)   # orthogonal-score variance
  t_value   <- theta / std_error
  p_value   <- 2 * (1 - pt(abs(t_value), df = n_keep - 1))

  g_at_D <- ifelse(Dk == 1, g1k, g0k)
  list(theta = theta, std_error = std_error, t_value = t_value, p_value = p_value,
       rmse_g = sqrt(mean((Yk - g_at_D)^2)), rmse_m = sqrt(mean((Dk - mk)^2)),
       trimmed_n = n_keep, trimming_threshold = trimming_threshold)
}
```

```{r run-plr}
model_types <- c("lasso", "tree", "rf", "nnet")

plr_results <- list()
for (model in model_types) {
  cat("Evaluating PLR with", model, "...\n")
  res <- tryCatch(
    double_ml_plr(model_val, y_col = outcome, d_col = treatment, x_cols = x_val,
                  k = 5, model_g = model, model_m = model),
    error = function(e) { cat("  error:", e$message, "\n"); NULL })
  if (!is.null(res))
    plr_results[[model]] <- data.frame(
      model = model, theta = res$theta, std_error = res$std_error,
      t_value = res$t_value, p_value = res$p_value,
      rmse_g = res$rmse_g, rmse_m = res$rmse_m)
}
plr_results_df <- do.call(rbind, plr_results)
cat("\nSummary of PLR results (outcome =", outcome, ", spec =", spec, "):\n")
print(plr_results_df, row.names = FALSE)
```

```{r run-irm}
irm_results <- list()
for (model in model_types) {
  cat("Evaluating IRM with", model, "...\n")
  res <- tryCatch(
    double_ml_irm(model_val, y_col = outcome, d_col = treatment, x_cols = x_val,
                  k = 5, model_g = model, model_m = model,
                  trimming_threshold = 1e-2),
    error = function(e) { cat("  error:", e$message, "\n"); NULL })
  if (!is.null(res))
    irm_results[[model]] <- data.frame(
      model = model, theta = res$theta, std_error = res$std_error,
      t_value = res$t_value, p_value = res$p_value,
      rmse_g = res$rmse_g, rmse_m = res$rmse_m, trimmed_n = res$trimmed_n)
}
irm_results_df <- do.call(rbind, irm_results)
cat("\nSummary of IRM results (outcome =", outcome, ", spec =", spec, "):\n")
print(irm_results_df, row.names = FALSE)
```
